<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 360" font-family="Impact, 'Arial Black', sans-serif">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="wm-chrome" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#f4f4f4"/>
      <stop offset="0.45" stop-color="#9aa0a6"/>
      <stop offset="0.55" stop-color="#5c6066"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#e8e8e8"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <style>
      .wm-needle{transform-origin:320px 230px;animation:wmsweep 2.6s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
      @keyframes wmsweep{0%{transform:rotate(-58deg)}100%{transform:rotate(58deg)}}
      .wm-tick{stroke:#c0392b;stroke-width:2}
    </style>
  </defs>
  <rect width="640" height="360" fill="#14100d"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="640" height="8" fill="#c0392b"/>
  <rect x="0" y="352" width="640" height="8" fill="#c0392b"/>

  <text x="320" y="90" text-anchor="middle" font-size="52" letter-spacing="3" fill="url(#wm-chrome)" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5">IRONCLAD MOTORS</text>
  <text x="320" y="130" text-anchor="middle" font-size="26" letter-spacing="10" fill="#c0392b">THE WIDOWMAKER</text>

  <!-- blast rating gauge -->
  <g>
    <path d="M 210 230 A 110 110 0 0 1 430 230" fill="none" stroke="#3a332c" stroke-width="14"/>
    <path d="M 210 230 A 110 110 0 0 1 430 230" fill="none" stroke="#c0392b" stroke-width="14" stroke-dasharray="345" stroke-dashoffset="60"/>
    <g class="wm-tick" transform="translate(320 230)"><line x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="-92"/></g>
    <circle cx="320" cy="230" r="10" fill="#e8e8e8"/>
    <text x="150" y="255" font-size="11" fill="#9aa0a6">SAFE</text>
    <text x="470" y="255" font-size="11" fill="#9aa0a6" text-anchor="end">FAMILY</text>
  </g>

  <text x="320" y="310" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" fill="#e8e8e8" letter-spacing="2">BLAST RATING: WHATEVER IT NEEDS TO BE</text>
  <text x="320" y="335" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="#7a7570" font-style="italic">Financing available. Ammunition sold separately, then included, then sold again.</text>
</svg>
description: Title card for the Ironclad Motors Widowmaker commercial.
name: Ironclad Motors — The Widowmaker — Logo
